title: Andy Taylor, guitarist of new wave icons Duran Duran, dies at 65
summary: Taylor revealed his battle with Stage 4 metastatic prostate cancer in 2022. He was the guitarist of the 1980s English band Duran Duran, whose pop hits included "Hungry Like the Wolf" and "Rio".
content: Taylor revealed his battle with Stage 4 metastatic prostate cancer in 2022. He was the guitarist of the 1980s English band Duran Duran, whose pop hits included "Hungry Like the Wolf" and "Rio". (Image credit: Jim Cooper)

title: FCC says SpaceX can deploy 1 million satellites for data centers in space. Scientists are skeptical
summary: The Trump administration gave Elon Musk's SpaceX the green light to deploy 1 million satellites that it said would create data centers in space, a move that has raised skepticism among scientists.
content: The Trump administration gave Elon Musk's SpaceX the green light to deploy 1 million satellites that it said would create data centers in space, a move that has raised skepticism among scientists. (Image credit: Julia Demaree Nikhinson)

title: At Albuquerque's Indian Pueblo Kitchen, Native American dishes are the main course
summary: At an Albuquerque, N.M., museum, the restaurant is just as much of a draw as the exhibitions, with dishes like green chile stew and sweet biscochitos flavored with anise and cinnamon.
content: At an Albuquerque, N.M., museum, the restaurant is just as much of a draw as the exhibitions, with dishes like green chile stew and sweet biscochitos flavored with anise and cinnamon. (Image credit: Adria Malcolm for NPR)

title: U.S. Judge rules FCC violated ABC's free speech rights to please Trump
summary: A federal judge has blocked the Trump administration from moving to review all local broadcast licenses held by ABC. The stations air in six of the largest U.S. markets.
content: A federal judge has blocked the Trump administration from moving to review all local broadcast licenses held by ABC. The stations air in six of the largest U.S. markets. (Image credit: Heather Diehl/Thibault Camus/Pool)

title: 'Memories of a Good Meal': How food made a difference during WWII
summary: New Orleans Chef Alon Shaya's new cookbook shares stories of resilience from World War II, centered around food.

title: Steelers cut Aaron Rodgers after the QB rips coach Mike McCarthy on TV
summary: The move capped a chaotic 18 hours in which the team announced it was benching the 42-year-old future Hall of Famer for backup Mason Rudolph ahead of Friday's visit from Denver.
